catalog_profile_email_valid.name: catalog_profile_email_valid
catalog_profile_email_valid.value: "catalog_profile"."email" IS NULL OR ("catalog_profile"."type"='contact' AND char_length("catalog_profile"."email") BETWEEN 1 AND 254 AND "catalog_profile"."email"=public.recruitment_trim("catalog_profile"."email") AND "catalog_profile"."email" ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$')

catalog_relation_shape_valid.name: catalog_relation_shape_valid
catalog_relation_shape_valid.value: ("catalog_relation"."type"='case-organization' AND "catalog_relation"."case_id" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_relation"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_relation"."contact_id" IS NULL AND "catalog_relation"."role" IN ('employer','agency')) OR ("catalog_relation"."type"='case-contact' AND "catalog_relation"."case_id" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_relation"."organization_id" IS NULL AND "catalog_relation"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_relation"."role" IS NULL) OR ("catalog_relation"."type"='organization-contact' AND "catalog_relation"."case_id" IS NULL AND "catalog_relation"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_relation"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_relation"."role" IS NULL)

recruitment_case_description_valid.name: recruitment_case_description_valid
recruitment_case_description_valid.value: "recruitment_case"."description" IS NULL OR (char_length("recruitment_case"."description") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND "recruitment_case"."description" = public.recruitment_trim("recruitment_case"."description"))

recruitment_case_url_valid.name: recruitment_case_url_valid
recruitment_case_url_valid.value: "recruitment_case"."source_url" IS NULL OR ("recruitment_case"."source_url" = public.recruitment_source_url("recruitment_case"."source_url") AND public.recruitment_source_url("recruitment_case"."source_url") IS NOT NULL)

recruitment_case_3b_status_stage.name: recruitment_case_3b_status_stage
recruitment_case_3b_status_stage.value: ("recruitment_case"."status" IN ('Zapisane', 'Kontakt rozpoczęty', 'Zakończone') AND "recruitment_case"."current_stage" IS NULL AND "recruitment_case"."stage_version" >= 0) OR ("recruitment_case"."status" = 'W rekrutacji' AND "recruitment_case"."current_stage" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("recruitment_case"."current_stage") BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND "recruitment_case"."current_stage" = public.recruitment_trim("recruitment_case"."current_stage") AND "recruitment_case"."stage_version" >= 1)

recruitment_case_event_3b_payload_valid.name: recruitment_case_event_3b_payload_valid
recruitment_case_event_3b_payload_valid.value: (("recruitment_case_event"."kind" = 'application' AND "recruitment_case_event"."direction" IS NULL) OR ("recruitment_case_event"."kind" = 'contact' AND "recruitment_case_event"."direction" IS NOT NULL AND "recruitment_case_event"."direction" IN ('inbound', 'outbound'))) AND "recruitment_case_event"."stage_name" IS NULL AND "recruitment_case_event"."previous_stage" IS NULL AND "recruitment_case_event"."expected_stage_version" IS NULL OR ("recruitment_case_event"."kind" IN ('invitation', 'stage-change') AND "recruitment_case_event"."direction" IS NULL AND "recruitment_case_event"."stage_name" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("recruitment_case_event"."stage_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND "recruitment_case_event"."stage_name" = public.recruitment_trim("recruitment_case_event"."stage_name") AND "recruitment_case_event"."expected_stage_version" IS NOT NULL AND "recruitment_case_event"."expected_stage_version" BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483646 AND ("recruitment_case_event"."previous_stage" IS NULL OR (char_length("recruitment_case_event"."previous_stage") BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND "recruitment_case_event"."previous_stage" = public.recruitment_trim("recruitment_case_event"."previous_stage"))))

recruitment_case_event_date_valid.name: recruitment_case_event_date_valid
recruitment_case_event_date_valid.value: "recruitment_case_event"."occurred_on" IS NULL OR ("recruitment_case_event"."occurred_on" >= DATE '0001-01-01' AND "recruitment_case_event"."occurred_on" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw')::date)
